title: Build a regression training audit

stages.title: Prediction and objective
stages.evidence: Shape contracts and independently checked scalar loss
stages.expected: PASS stage 1: prediction, objective, and shape contract
stages.diagnosis: If shapes differ, inspect the model output and target axes before changing the loss reduction.

stages.title: Gradient evidence
stages.evidence: Autodiff and finite differences at two settings
stages.expected: PASS stage 2: independent gradients at two parameter settings
stages.diagnosis: If the derivative check fails, compare the stable independent loss and finite-difference tolerance. Preserve the same initialized parameters for both checks.

stages.title: Compiled training
stages.evidence: Recovered parameters and complete loss history
stages.expected: PASS stage 3: compiled training and parameter recovery
stages.diagnosis: If training fails, inspect the complete loss history and explicit state transition. Keep the failure output and compare held-out evaluation without mutating model state.

stages.title: Training audit
stages.evidence: Held-out performance, replay, and an unstable run
stages.expected: PASS stage 4: held-out checks, replay, and failure diagnosis
stages.diagnosis: If the audit fails, separate replay, held-out checks and deliberately unstable training; a low training loss alone cannot satisfy all three.

rubric: Implement matching prediction/target shapes and scalar loss
Recover known parameters with compiled state transitions
Distinguish training fit from held-out checks
Diagnose an unstable learning rate with recorded evidence
setupNote: Extract the ZIP into a fresh folder. That folder contains requirements-cpu.txt and projects/regression-audit. Use the extracted top folder as your working directory; a full course checkout is optional for this project.
